report:
Reviewed the complete bounded_completeness claim, ordinary solve_query implementation association, explicit implementation TODO and sole TODO test. Captured the solver design, accepted groundness/resource-bound and terminal-incompleteness RFD sections, and goal definition containing the current depth limit. Source inspection only; no test execution or source changes.

The claim requires sound terminating non-ground answers, ground completeness unless a named deterministic resource limit is reached, and distinctions between candidate incompleteness, ambiguity and each overflow class, with none treated as logical No. solve_query validates canonical input, creates local proof state and a whiteboard, drives proof/normalization and returns a canonical result, asserting no remaining proof branches for the proof path. prove_atom checks MAX_PROOF_DEPTH (currently 64) before another request and returns Maybe on exhaustion, not No. Frame reuse includes remaining depth and parent context. Candidate-source incompleteness is carried to answer merging rather than being inferred as exhaustive absence. These are present mechanisms, not the full destination contract.

The implementation TODO explicitly states that ground completeness and the full deterministic resource taxonomy remain planned. In particular the current depth path yields the same broad Maybe representation rather than demonstrating named, separate depth/term-size/logical-work/fixpoint overflow outcomes. The source also contains inductive ancestor-cycle handling, which is distinct from the depth-exhaustion branch and is not interpreted here as a generic resource failure. I do not claim universal termination, ground completeness, polling-order invariance or every incomplete-source outcome from this limited source assessment.

The sole solver_bounded_completeness test has no assertions and is explicitly TODO. It requires ground positive/negative cases, non-ground ambiguity with an available instantiation, incomplete candidate sources, every configured limit class, repeated canonical outcome determinism and no incomplete/exhausted No. Completing the missing groundness/resource-result implementation and this fixture matrix is the prerequisite for full verification. The normative RFD is accounted for without weakening its distinct-outcome requirement or treating the existing depth Maybe as satisfying it. Both implementation entries and the evidence entry are accurately represented as partial implementation plus explicit deferral, so no additional edits are requested.
